messages:
emma: running into a hang in the sampleapp streaming flow when our proxy returns 429 + Retry-After during reconnect. node & python clients both. anyone seen similar?

rafael: which SDK versions and minimal repro?

emma: node sampleapp 0.9.3, python 0.7.1. repro: start a long SSE stream, force proxy to 429 on reconnect, client reconnects with Last-Event-Id but then stops emitting final events. logs show a partial data fragment then EOF: [DEBUG] recv "data: {\"id\":\"e_11\",\"text\":\"Hel\"\" then [DEBUG] recv "lo\n\n" then parser errors with unexpected EOF.

priya: two common causes: 1) Last-Event-Id header getting dropped during token refresh, 2) parser not preserving trailing partial chunk across reconnect.

rafael: also seen proxy buffered flush send older TCP segment after new connection, resulting in reordering. adding a small seq field in payload helped detect when events are stale/duplicated.

emma: i can reproduce with a tiny nginx conf that returns 429 on the reconnect path. i'll add it to flaky CI.

priya: short-term fixes: ensure SDK preserves Last-Event-Id across auth refresh; make parser accumulate data: lines until full "\n\n" terminator and prepend leftover on reconnect. Also drop duplicates when event.id <= lastSeen.

rafael: i'll prototype a parser change for node. priya can handle python header-preserve. emma will add CI job and repro.

stream-bot: created issue #1709: "sse: sampleapp stall on 429 reconnect (proxy flush/reorder)" with logs and nginx config.

emma: thanks — once we have PRs let's canary the staging sampleapp for 12h and check continuity metrics.
